import json,urllib.request,concurrent.futures
ok=json.load(open("ob_live.json"))

    p={"model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":10}
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=json.dumps(p).encode(),
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {k}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=90) as x: return (k,item[1],item[2],"CHAT_OK")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return (k,item[1],item[2],f"HTTP{e.code}")
    except Exception: return (k,item[1],item[2],"ERR")

    f.write("# model    : deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored\n")
    f.write("# format   : api_key | saldo\n")
    for i,(k,idx,bal,st) in enumerate(good,1):
        f.write(f"{i:3d}. {k} | ${bal:.4f}\n")
print("tersimpan: ob_live_keys.txt")
